$comment: Refused self-billed invoices (sales-einvoice-exchange REQ-SEIX-006). A self-billed invoice received over Peppol that did not become a draft sales invoice (no matching administration or customer, no current self-billing agreement, or an unreadable document) is recorded as a SelfBilledInvoiceRefusal by SelfBilledInvoiceIntake; this page lists them for the bookkeeper with the reason. Read-only: the records are written by the intake, never by hand.

config.description: Self-billed invoices a customer sent over Peppol that did not become a sales invoice, with the reason.
